title: Master Page - that The user cannot edit the Data Type of any column once it has been saved.
preconditions:
1.URL must be working
2.user should be on FMS home page

steps.action: Go to Extraction & Load Layer -> Column Configuration
steps.expectedResult: User should redirect to the list page
User should redirect to the master page

steps.action: Now try to edit the data type of any column
steps.expectedResult: User is not allowed to edit the data type of the column
